candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement to return address(0) instead of _owner.
Change the return statement to return msg.sender instead of the stored owner.
Replace the ownership transfer target with the zero address so owner() becomes address(0) after any call.
Swap the order of the require check and the ownership transfer so a zero-address input still transfers ownership (to address(0)) instead of reverting.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from setOperator so any caller can set the operator.
Replace the assignment so operator is set to msg.sender instead of the provided argument.
Replace the assignment so operator is set to the current owner instead of the provided argument.
Remove the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so guarded functions like setOperator can be invoked by anyone.
